basic_details.job_title: Bhadradri Kothagudem District Gynaecologist Specialist Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: Bhadradri Kothagudem District has notified 1 vacancy for the Gynaecologist Specialist post on a contract basis. Candidates holding a PG Degree/Diploma are eligible to apply for this position posted at Bhadrachalam. The notified pay for the Gynecology Specialist Doctor post is Rs. 20,00,000.00 per month. Applicants must submit the filled application by hand or post to the Superintendent, District Headquarters Hospitals Principal Office, # S26, Integrated District Offices Complex (IDOC), Old Palvancha. The last date to apply is 4 November 2026 under advertisement number Rec.Cell/SDHQH/2026-27.

qualification.education_qualification: Post Graduate Degree/Diploma in Clinical Medical Speciality

selection_process: Please refer to the official notification for selection process details.
how_to_apply: Candidates who wish to apply for Bhadradri Kothagudem District Gynecology Specialist Doctor Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below.
Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Download the application form from the official website: https://kothagudem.telangana.gov.in.
Fill the application form carefully with correct information.
Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates.
Check all details carefully before submission.
Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed.
Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 04-11-2026.
Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by Bhadradri Kothagudem District in the state of Telangana to fill healthcare positions on a contract basis under advertisement number Rec.Cell/SDHQH/2026-27.

faq.question: Q2. What position is being offered in this notification?
faq.answer: The notification invites applications for the post of Gynecology Specialist Doctor to be placed at Bhadrachalam with a total vacancy count of 1 position.

faq.question: Q3. What is the required educational qualification for the post?
faq.answer: Candidates applying for the Gynecology Specialist Doctor position must possess a Post Graduate Degree or Diploma in a Clinical Medical Speciality.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for this position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Gynecology Specialist Doctor post will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 2,000,000.00 as specified in the official notification.

faq.question: Q5. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is completely offline. Candidates must download the form and submit it by hand or post.

faq.question: Q6. What is the last date to submit the offline application?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the filled offline application form is 4 November 2026. Applicants must ensure timely delivery before this date.

faq.question: Q7. Where should the completed application form be sent?
faq.answer: Filled applications must be submitted to the Superintendent, District Headquarters Hospitals Principal Office, # S26, Integrated District Offices Complex (IDOC), Old Palvancha.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No application fee has been stated or mentioned in the official notification for applying to the Gynecology Specialist Doctor position.

faq.question: Q9. What is the official website to download the application form?
faq.answer: Candidates can download the official application form and check further details by visiting the official website at https://kothagudem.telangana.gov.in.

faq.question: Q10. What is the nature of the job for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The job offered under this recruitment notification by Bhadradri Kothagudem District is strictly on a contract basis in the healthcare sector.
